h1: A professionally built and managed website for one simple monthly price — with no upfront cost.

sections.subheading: Custom design, hosting, maintenance and ongoing support included — with no large upfront website fee.

sections.intro: Every plan is billed monthly in USD, with no activation fee and no long-term contract — see exactly what's included below.

note.body: Cancel anytime — you stay because you're getting value, not because you're locked in.

sections.heading: Support and value, in our clients’ words
Included on every plan
sections.intro: Regardless of which plan you choose, these are never an upsell.

items.title: Custom design
items.body: Every site is designed for your business — no drag-and-drop templates.

items.title: Domain, hosting & security
items.body: Domain connection, managed hosting, SSL and monthly uptime monitoring, included.

items.title: Mobile-responsive by default
items.body: Every page is built to work correctly on phones, tablets and desktops.

items.title: Managed for you
items.body: We take care of ongoing maintenance, routine content updates, security monitoring, backups, and technical support — so your website stays secure, updated, and running smoothly without you having to manage it yourself.

sections.heading: Commitment and ownership

items.title: Domain ownership
body: Your domain always belongs to you.
Whether you stay with us for one month or several years, your domain remains in your name and under your control.

items.title: No Minimum Term
body: Plans are billed month to month with no activation fee and no minimum commitment. You stay because the service is valuable, not because you're locked in.

items.title: Website Ownership
body: After six consecutive paid months, the completed website is yours.
If you decide to leave after that, we'll provide your website files at no additional charge. If you cancel earlier, you still keep your domain and any content you originally supplied.

items.title: Add-ons & third-party charges
items.body: Third-party services are charged separately where applicable. Items such as additional Google Workspace email accounts, premium software, paid integrations, licences, or other external services are billed separately and clearly agreed with you in advance.

sections.subheading: No long-term contract. Cancel anytime. And after six months, you own the website.

sections.heading: Ready to see your business with a better website?
sections.body: We'll create a private preview using your real business information. Review it before deciding whether to work with us.
